title: Presenting humanoid-robot social mirroring research at HRI 2024
excerpt: Dr Di Fu presented Human Impression of Humanoid Robots Mirroring Social Cues at ACM/IEEE HRI 2024 in Boulder, Colorado. The study compares how robot platforms and control methods influence people's perceptions of affective and movement mirroring.

titleZh: 在HRI 2024介绍人形机器人社会镜像研究
